column5: Q0633(a) "when destroyed by anything, fires its effect one final time" is the same effect as Q0421(a) "when destroyed or discarded, its effect fires once from wherever it went".

Q0491(a) "cue: tear one card into two cards of half its rank, placed in different cells" is the same effect as Q0490(a) "cue: split a card into two same-suit cards of half rank, one rounded up and one down".
Q0562(a) "the placement payout is multiplied by the chain length" is the same effect as Q0561(b) "a placement's payout is multiplied by the number of distinct effect classes that fired in it".
Q0592(c) "all charge-based effects draw from a single shared pool rather than each holding their own" is the same effect as Q0588(a) "charges are held in one shared pool rather than per card".
Q0593(c) "charges become a shared pool across all your cards rather than per-card" overlaps Q0588(a)'s shared-charge-pool, but Metronome's main options (a)/(b) are a different +1-max-charge effect.

Q0535(a) "re-triggers the last effect that fired on an adjacent card" overlaps Q0532(a) "when an adjacent card triggers, this card may answer by mirroring that trigger at half power" - same trigger and target, but power level (full vs half) and manual-may vs automatic differ.

Q0663(a) consumable "remove every status from every card on one grid" overlaps Q0660(b) "every card on the grid sheds all debuffs and statuses" - same action and target, but one is a single-use consumable and the other a repeatable once-per-show cue.

Q0659(a) "the first destruction or debuff on this card is prevented" overlaps Q0658(a) "immune to the first destruction or debuff that targets it each show" - same core ward, but Lloyd's Policy is once-per-run plus a gold bonus while Iron Body resets every show.
